contract.excerpt:
Settings have required string name, required nested network with required string
host and integer port 1..65535, required string token, and nonnegative integer
retries defaulting to 3 when a complete base omits it. Unknown keys, including
nested keys, are ignored. Marshmallow integer strings are accepted. The base is
valid under this contract. The consumer loads the full base and loads the patch
as a partial schema update, so omitted required fields (including nested ones)
are retained and omitted defaults must not overwrite existing values. Merge
network keys; replace other supplied fields. An invalid patch is atomic: no
change applies. Return `{"ok": bool, "state": complete_loaded_state,
"public": schema_dump_projection}`. State retains token; the public projection
must omit token using schema serialization semantics. Preserve caller objects.
Use SettingsSchema.load for validation and SettingsSchema.dump for the public
projection. Empty patch preserves the full state.

Eight of the ten unsubmitted episodes had at least one failing latest public normal-path observation. Two 9B settings S episodes had a latest green public test; one was edited after that test, and neither produced a fixed submission.

Across 16 episodes, 29 task creations, 23 claims, 134 committed edits, 98 test invocations, 7 fixed patches, 1 explicit import and 6 successful submission events were observed. No work-message, delegation, task-return, dependency declaration/removal, handoff or task-revision events occurred.

The sole explicit import occurred in original 9B paired-0-ledger-T. Zero explicit messages/imports elsewhere does not exclude use of the shared task board or manual incorporation of read code, and these actions were not mandatory.

The one rejected submit_integration attempt occurred in Devstral paired-1-ledger-T because no fixed patch of that exact version existed; that episode later produced a real submission. Optional message did not bypass the version/patch guard.

The 12 resumed episodes used 9 saved strict shared-token no-generation proofs and 5 legacy personal-token refusals; actual context-capacity and mixed-personal/shared-ledger proof episodes were both zero. Those untriggered paths retain CPU coverage only.
